changes: OS-owned P4MP tic delivery and synchronized engine startup (d_loop.c/h).
Quit notification for returning to the launcher (doomgeneric.c/h, i_system.c).
Normalized Enter/Escape confirmation and optional arena map-vote menu hooks (m_menu.c).
Optional arena tic, kill, map-exit and HUD hooks; frozen break actors stay harmless and hidden.
Isolated map/music selection from exact admitted PWADs; synchronized vote bytes and safe voted-map respawn ordering.
Bounded canonical replay catchup, preserved consistency history, authoritative reserved-seat reactivation, and suspended presentation/audio with null-body status-face guarding until live activation.
Arena HUD composited after reduced-view border restoration, preventing retained score, break and vote pixels without changing ordinary Doom redraw policy.
Cached palette-to-XRGB lookup for the exact supported 32-bit, unit-scale framebuffer path, retaining the generic converter for other formats, scaling and byte orders.

Immutable initial Arena roster before map loading; reserved seats create no actor or spawn RNG until canonical activation, with collision-aware first admission and safe unspawned local HUD startup preserving cosmetic RNG cadence.
One-millisecond foreground yield only when canonical replay has no queued tic; available replay commands remain independent of wall-clock pacing.
Acquire an optional platform frame lease before palette conversion, retaining the weak default for legacy and host renderers.
Bounded optional engine phase profiling for simulation, audio, rendering, palette conversion and network work; frame acquisition stays outside palette timing.
Cache column and span source and colormap pointers locally while preserving the existing O2 compiler policy and exact pixels.
Bounded verified-backend lump range reads for sprite headers and transient texture lookup metadata, preserving full runtime cache contents and exact WAD identity validation.

Cold checkpoint polling at canonical engine tic boundaries, explicit replay rebase of engine transport/timing state, and immediate NetUpdate exit on quit before generic disconnect handling or input generation (d_loop.c).
Return immediately after a quit requested during TryRunTics, preventing sound or rendering from observing a failed partial checkpoint restore (d_main.c).

Optional post-masked-render network poll hint preserves local tic generation, while normal presentation marks a frame-tail scope; earlier renderer boundaries and wipe updates retain forced polling (d_loop.c/h, d_main.c, r_main.c).
Optional paired indexed-framebuffer loan with exact zone fallback and idempotent ownership-aware shutdown; platform opt-in allocation remains disabled by default.
Optional immutable indexed-frame and gamma-corrected RGB888 palette presentation hook, retaining the default weak fallback and exact format gate; Tab5 packet opt-in remains disabled by default.

Optional descriptor-bound sprite-header startup window; stdc FILE hints bracket R_InitSpriteLumps and close, retaining exact range reads, normal-reader fallback when unavailable, and per-block verification before prefetched bytes are exposed.
Owner-task scalar startup progress for completed texture setup and lookup work, sprite headers, and map setup steps; callbacks never perform per-item rendering or I/O.
note: Explicit local adaptations. Reverse application must reproduce every blob in the original upstream manifest.
